fields.description: How the loan tab of /commons/banking guesses which loan a deposit repays. Each kind of evidence adds its weight to a loan's score, and loans are offered best first. A suggestion resting on the party, a repeated identifier or the borrower's name is put into the draft for the bookkeeper to confirm; one resting only on a single earlier identifier is listed, not put in. A weight of 0 leaves that evidence out.
fields.label: Loan Matching

fields.description: The party on the statement line is the loan's borrower. Strong evidence.
fields.label: Party Match Weight

fields.description: An identifier on the line (a long run of digits: an account, phone or wallet number) was on two or more earlier repayments of this loan and of no other. Strong evidence.
fields.label: Repeated Identifier Weight

fields.description: An identifier on the line was on one earlier repayment of this loan and of no other. Weak evidence: banks put their own clearing accounts and transaction numbers in descriptions too.
fields.label: Single Identifier Weight

fields.description: Every part of the borrower's name is in the line's description. Strong evidence.
fields.label: Name in Description Weight

fields.description: Tie-breaker only: the deposit pays the loan's outstanding principal off exactly. Never enough on its own to suggest a loan.
fields.label: Exact Payoff Tie-Break

fields.description: Tie-breaker only: the deposit is an amount the borrower has paid on this loan before. Never enough on its own to suggest a loan.
fields.label: Usual Amount Tie-Break

fields.description: How many digits in a row count as an identifier. Shorter runs (dates, amounts, branch codes) are ignored.
fields.label: Minimum Identifier Digits

fields.description: A borrower known by a single word is looked for in descriptions only if the word is at least this long, so that a short common name does not match every line.
fields.label: Minimum Single-Word Name Length

fields.description: The Repayment Type of a Loan Repayment the page books from a deposit. One of Lending's own types.
fields.label: Repayment Type
